name: CasePresenceHiddenAxisGeometry
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "presence-hidden-axis-geometry" (tokens). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: an absolute part's inset that is a clean function of ONE enum axis, with the part NOT RENDERED at one axis value (polaris.checkbox icon: top/left 0px when checked, -2px when indeterminate, absent when unchecked)
